summary: CICS online Transaction-Type (reference data) Update screen. The user retrieves a transaction type/category record, edits its fields (type code, category code, description, and any associated attributes), and saves. Validates the fields, compares old vs new, and rewrites the record only if it changed and was not modified by another user since it was read (optimistic concurrency). Pseudo-conversational. (Large program -- key logic paragraphs summarized; the remainder are screen setup/attribute boilerplate.)

paragraphs.name: 0000-MAIN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Pseudo-conversational entry. On first entry send the transaction-type update screen. On re-entry evaluate the key and state (PF3 exit; Enter process/edit; confirm to update) via the action decision; read the type record, validate edits, and on confirmation commit the update. Return to CICS with the COMMAREA.

paragraphs.name: 1000-PROCESS-INPUTS
paragraphs.pseudocode: Receive the map and validate the transaction-type fields.

paragraphs.name: 1200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS
paragraphs.pseudocode: Validate the transaction-type inputs: type code present and valid, category code valid, description present and within length; set an error flag if any fail.

annotations.note: BUSINESS RULE: transaction type code and category must be valid and a description is required to maintain a type record.

paragraphs.name: 2000-DECIDE-ACTION
paragraphs.pseudocode: Decide the next step from program state and edit results: prompt for a type, show fetched values, confirm changes, or perform the update.

paragraphs.name: 3000-SEND-MAP
paragraphs.pseudocode: Build and send the transaction-type update map (init, set variables, info message, attributes, transmit).
paragraphs.notes: Screen send orchestrator (setup paragraphs omitted as boilerplate).

paragraphs.name: 9000-READ-DATA
paragraphs.pseudocode: Read the transaction-type record by its key and snapshot it as the baseline for change/concurrency checking.

paragraphs.name: 9200-WRITE-PROCESSING
paragraphs.pseudocode: Commit the update: re-read the type record, verify it has not changed since it was displayed, and if unchanged rewrite it with the edited values; otherwise report a concurrent-change error.
branches: IF changed since read -> concurrency error

annotations.note: BUSINESS RULE: reference-data update applied only if the record was not changed by another user since it was read (optimistic concurrency).

paragraphs.notes: BUSINESS-CRITICAL: reference-data update with concurrency control.

paragraphs.name: 9300-CHECK-CHANGE-IN-REC
paragraphs.pseudocode: Compare the re-read type record against the baseline snapshot to detect concurrent modification.

paragraphs.name: COMMON-RETURN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Save state and CICS RETURN with the transaction id.
